transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, my wife wanted me to come. She says I don't really... feel things anymore. Like, even when she tries to get us to do our old Sunday routines, or... or if something goes right at work. I just don't feel any real happiness or... closeness to anyone. It's just flat.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... a while now. I guess, since the accident at the retrofit project. That was about... a year and seven months ago.
Have you had any periods in the past where you felt overwhelmingly sad or depressed?
No. I haven't. Just... just what I told you.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable, such as hobbies or spending time with friends?
Not really. I don't... I don't do much of that anymore. I just haven't had the interest.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah. Like I... like I just said. I just don't have much interest in any of it anymore.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed most of the day?
No. I... I think I already answered that. I haven't had anything like that.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
No. I... I haven't noticed any change.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you pleasure?
Yeah, I guess so. I just... I don't feel real happiness anymore. Even when my wife tries to get me to do our old Sunday routines, or... or if something goes well at work. I just don't feel it.
Have you had periods of feeling depressed in the past that have gone away on their own?
No. I don't... I haven't had anything like that in the past.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasurable or enjoyable?
No. I... like I said, I just don't feel that anymore. Not happiness, not... closeness with my wife. Just... nothing really does it.
How long have you felt this lack of interest and flatness?
Since... the accident. The retrofit accident. That was... I guess about a year and seven months ago now. Just... since then.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
No. I wouldn't call it sad. I just... like I said, I don't really feel much of anything. Just empty.
Do you feel that this flatness and lack of interest are interfering with your daily life?

Yeah, I suppose it is. I... at work, I've had to pass off a lot of the floor duties I used to handle. Just can't... do it right now. And I had an interview for a regional director spot a while back, but I... I kind of lost my composure and just walked out. So that's gone. And at home... like I said, things are strained. I'm there, but I'm not really... there.
Do you feel depressed?
I don't know. Like I just said... I'm not sad. I don't know if that means depressed. I just... don't feel much of anything.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find absolutely no pleasure in?

Yeah... I suppose. My wife... she tries to get me to do our old Sunday routines. Things we used to like. But I just... I don't get anything out of it. I don't feel any real happiness or closeness anymore. Even if something actually goes well at work, I just... I don't feel it.
Do you feel like you're depressed most of the day?
I... I really don't know. Like I said, I don't feel sad. It's just... whatever this empty feeling is, it's just there. All day. I wouldn't call it being depressed, I'm just... blank.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood most days?
I... didn't you just ask me that? I don't know what else to say. Like I just said, I wouldn't call it a depressed mood. It's just... that same blank feeling. Every day.
Has this empty feeling you're experiencing been constant since the accident, or have you had any periods where it lifted or improved?
I don't know... I guess it's just been constant. Ever since it happened. I haven't really noticed it lifting or anything. It's just always there.
Have you ever had a two-week period where you felt depressed nearly every day?
No. I... I don't really track things by the week. But like I keep saying, I wouldn't call it depressed. So... no, I don't think so. Just what I already told you.
Has this feeling of emptiness and lack of interest lasted for more than two years?
No, not two years. It's... it's been since the accident. At the retrofit. That was about a year and seven months ago, I think. So... no, not quite two years.
